note: FORMS OF A NAME THE ARCHIVE'S OWN DATA STATES FOR A PERSON WHO ALREADY HAS A PAGE. tools/build-names-index.py reads this file and adds each form to that person's page in the names index, so the linker (autolink) can link it. An alias is a claim that two written names are one person, so each carries the record that says so; the generator checks that the person exists and is not living, and then applies the same safety filters as every other form (a form a living, held-out, not-known-dead or second person also bears is dropped, so is a form inside a longer unlinked name). Edit by hand, with the record, in a commit that says why. No living person, ever.

aliases.basis: The Wedding death entry of 27 February 1943 (Sterberegister 1943 Nr. 1291) names her Gertrud Sara Leibholz, and her birth family is Leibke (data/gertrud-leibholz-sterbeeintrag-1943.tsv). The bare form Gertrud Leibholz is NOT added: a Gertrud Meyer née Leibholz is also in the Gedenkbuch.

She married Jacob Leibholz at Schöneberg on 5 January 1924 (data/leibholz-luwinski-1924-entry.tsv); the Arolsen index enters her as Leibholz, Auguste, maiden name Luwwinsky (data/arolsen-leibholz-luwinski.tsv), and the 1939 census card is hers under that name.
He signs his 1939 passport Israel Kurt Luwinski (data/kurt-papers-1934-1939.tsv); the Transvaal court files index him as Luwinsky and Luwenski (data/litigation.tsv, site/src/data/names.json).

Her spellings are the subject of site/src/data/names.json: the 1922 birth registration and its averbamento (Mata), the 2010 death certificate (Mota de Figueiredo), the Transvaal court files (de Figueiredo, Mota Figueiredo, Luwenski) (data/ivone-assento-nascimento-1922.tsv, data/ivone-death-certificate-2010.tsv, data/litigation.tsv).
The Citizen (Letchworth) of 6 November 1914 prints her wedding as Miss Martha Maude Castle of Baldock (data/wear-castle-wedding-1914-newspapers.tsv).

data/naa-recordsearch.tsv and data/luwinski-emigration-1965.tsv write Manfred's wife as Helga Erna Marquardt; the family tree carries her as Helga Erna Marquardt Wagner (Luwinski), the form on her page.

data/shenton-line-closed.tsv and data/shenton-1939-pix-road.tsv: Emma Hull, born Aldenham, is Emma Hawkins, widow of Robert Wear and remarried to John Hull; the 1939 Register enters her at 63 Pix Road as Emma Hull, widowed, and the death index has Emma Hull in Q2 1944, aged 85.
He is Joachim Peter on every official document and Peter in Melbourne society: the Age of 2 October 1954 prints him as Mr. and Mrs. Peter Leibholz (data/trove-2026-09-27.tsv).
